title: Canonical Event Envelope
description: The single canonical event schema for all constitutional events. No competing event schemas allowed.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event (UUID v4)

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor that initiated this event

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred

lineage.description: Lineage information tracking provenance and causality

parent_event_ids.description: IDs of events that directly caused this event

causal_chain.description: Full causal chain from root event to this event

branch.description: Git branch where this event occurred

commit.description: Git commit hash at time of event

policy_version.description: Version of the constitutional policy that evaluated this event
